01 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE STORY

More than a name.
A work in progress.

A little about where I come from, what inspires me, and what I’m working toward.

HELLO, I'M LOURENCE

Curious by nature.
Creative by choice.

I'm Lourence TJ, from Inarado, Daraga, Albay. I enjoy exploring technology, learning how things work, and turning ideas into something people can actually experience.

I'm interested in web development, digital design, and building projects that feel thoughtful and useful. I believe growth comes from staying curious, trying again, and being willing to learn along the way.

This space is a collection of the things that matter to me: where I started, what I've created, and the future I'm still working toward.
